| Image | Noisy | 2 orient. | 4 orient. | 8 orient. | Soft 1.5 | Wavelet | Stationary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lines | 22.18 | 27.88 | 28.76 | 28.99 | 28.16 | 27.12 | 28.24 |
| Disks | 22.66 | 31.81 | 32.75 | 33.16 | 31.03 | 29.80 | 30.92 |

The PSNR in dB against the clean image, for Gaussian noise of sigma 20 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. Both images are 160 by 160 pixels. The lines image has three straight lines, 3 pixels wide. The orientation columns use hard thresholding with factor 3 and 4 levels. Soft 1.5 uses 4 orientations and soft thresholding with factor 1.5. Wavelet is wavelet thresholding and Stationary is stationary wavelet filtering, both with their defaults.

With factor 0, the result equals the clean disks in every pixel, so the pyramid gives the image back. For an image of 256 by 256 pixels with 4 orientations, the norm of the band filter, which is the noise level for sigma 1, is 0.278, 0.555, 1.110, 2.220 from level 1 to level 4. It doubles with each level, since pyrtools does not rescale the spectrum when it crops it to half the size.
